name: Q-SYS Core (QRC)
hint: audio.control: the control's name, an equals sign and a number, for example Main Gain=-10 (the name is the control's Script Access name in Q-SYS Designer). audio.snapshot: the snapshot's name, a slash and its bank number, for example Show Open/1
notes: Q-SYS's external control protocol (QRC) as remembered from its documentation: JSON-RPC 2.0 over TCP port 1710, each message ended by a zero byte, Control.Set with Name and Value, Snapshot.Load with Name and Bank. Not checked against a running Core or its documentation, so confirm the method names, the port and the terminator against your Designer version before a show. A Core that requires a login is not supported: there is no Logon, and no password can be put in a profile. Each cue opens a connection, sends one request, reads one answer and closes.
